summary: National Grid plc filed a preliminary prospectus supplement for an offering of senior unsecured notes due 2026. The terms (interest rate, maturity, offering price) remain blank because the supplement is preliminary. The notes rank pari passu with existing unsubordinated debt and are effectively subordinated to secured debt. Use of proceeds is not yet specified. The filing is a routine debt shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5); it does not involve any special-situations event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. This is an ordinary capital markets transaction with no special-situation classification.
